system.description: As part of casting a jutsu with the Medical or Inhaled keyword that forces a saving throw, you infuse this bane and any creature that fails their save, you can select either Strength, Intelligence or Wisdom. For the next minute, the affected creature gains a d4 penalty to attacks or saves with the chosen ability. If the chosen jutsu allows the affected creature to remake their saving throw, they end this effect on a success. If the chosen jutsu does not allow a resave, then the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.
